decision: Source image keeps the factory PICO/QTI Bluetooth stack instead of AOSP packages/apps/Bluetooth and system/bt. The framework side stays Source with the factory IBluetooth transaction table (patches 0048-0049). Restoring an own QTI stack is deferred (REMAINING-WORK.md).

not_copied.system/app/Bluetooth/oat: odex/vdex were compiled against the factory boot image; the Source boot classpath differs, so they are dropped and the APK is compiled for the Source boot image

system_configuration.package: com.android.bluetooth, sharedUserId android.uid.bluetooth; org.codeaurora.bluetooth (BluetoothExt, IBluetoothDun server)
system_configuration.certificate: factory APK signatures are kept (PRESIGNED); android.uid.bluetooth and signature permissions require the Source platform packages to use the same certificate set as the factory preserved layer
system_configuration.permissions: BLUETOOTH, BLUETOOTH_ADMIN, BLUETOOTH_STACK group mapping as in factory system/etc/permissions/platform.xml
system_configuration.selinux: plat_seapp_contexts user=bluetooth domain=bluetooth; plat_file_contexts /system/bin/bt_logger bt_logger_exec, /data/misc/bluedroid and /data/misc/bluetooth labels
system_configuration.vendor: factory vendor keeps android.hardware.bluetooth@1.0, bluetooth.audio@2.0 and vendor.qti.hardware.btconfigstore HALs unchanged

source_requirements.native: android.hidl.base@1.0 must be installed on system (PRODUCT_PACKAGES in device.mk); libbluetooth_qti and libbtconfigstore link it. All other DT_NEEDED and symbols of the 15 preserved ELF files resolve in the Source outputs.

framework_aidl.android.bluetooth.IBluetoothGatt: factory table has 57 transactions: registerCallback(IBluetoothLeCallback)=56, unregisterCallback=57 appended
framework_aidl.android.bluetooth.le.IBluetoothLeCallbac: factory-only interface: onRegisterClientApp=1, onUnRegisterClientApp=2, onRegisterServerApp=3, onUnRegisterServerApp=4 (String package), not oneway
framework_aidl.com.android.internal.app.IBatteryStats: factory appends getIBatteryStatsOptEx=90 (Smartisan layer, stage 3); codes 1-89 match, Bluetooth.apk does not call it

source_requirements.selinux: CodeLinaro device/qcom/sepolicy qva (bt_logger domain, /system/bin/bt_logger, Bluetooth property contexts) and the reconstructed factory PICO platform policy (tools/reconstruct-factory-sepolicy.py, validation/sepolicy-parity.json)
